sql.query: SELECT DISTINCT u.id AS userId,COALESCE(NULLIF(u.displayName,''),CONCAT_WS(' ',u.fName,u.lName),u.email) AS memberName FROM tbl_teams t INNER JOIN tbl_team_members tm ON tm.teamId=t.id AND tm.tenantId=t.tenantId AND tm.isActive=1 INNER JOIN tbl_user_tenants ut ON ut.id=tm.userTenantId AND ut.tenantId=t.tenantId AND ut.isActive=1 AND ut.membershipStatus='active' INNER JOIN tbl_users u ON u.id=ut.userId AND u.isActive=1 WHERE t.id=:teamId AND t.tenantId=:tenantId AND t.isActive=1 AND (EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM tbl_user_tenant_roles utr INNER JOIN tbl_roles r ON r.id=utr.roleId AND r.isActive=1 AND r.roleKey IN ('owner','admin') WHERE utr.userId=:adminUserId AND utr.tenantId=t.tenantId AND utr.isActive=1) OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM tbl_user_tenants managerTenant INNER JOIN tbl_team_members managerMember ON managerMember.userTenantId=managerTenant.id AND managerMember.tenantId=managerTenant.tenantId AND managerMember.teamId=t.id AND managerMember.isActive=1 INNER JOIN tbl_team_member_roles managerRole ON managerRole.teamMemberId=managerMember.id AND managerRole.isActive=1 INNER JOIN tbl_team_role_permissions trp ON trp.teamRoleId=managerRole.teamRoleId INNER JOIN tbl_permissions p ON p.id=trp.permissionId AND p.permissionCode='team.tasks.assign' AND p.isActive=1 WHERE managerTenant.userId=:managerUserId AND managerTenant.tenantId=t.tenantId AND managerTenant.isActive=1 AND managerTenant.membershipStatus='active')) ORDER BY memberName
